title: Taric Core Contracts v1
description: Phase 1 单机首发领域合同。所有合同都是严格的：缺失字段、额外字段、格式错误和非法枚举一律拒绝。

recallStatus.description: 记忆生命周期状态。retracted/superseded/archived/stale/expired 必须被排除出当前 recall。

artifactReference.description: Opaque Artifact reference. Content may remain external or be explicitly stored in a bound task session.

coreManagedFields.description: 由 Core writer 分配或维护的字段。调用者不得设置；schema 允许它们存在，只是为了让权威记录可以被校验。

authMetadata.description: 只允许非秘密的认证/会话元数据。凭据和 token 不属于这里。

allOf.description: Immutable content and applicability snapshot for one variant of a stable logical resource. The record ID is UUIDv7; display_id is an optional Core-assigned TAR alias.
